types.description: Three-pole thermal-magnetic motor protection breaker, 24–32 A, rotary knob; bare device

document.title: Schneider Electric Product data sheet GV2P32 (manufacturer-authored, iLECSYS mirror)

modelingNotes: Manufacturer catalog spelling GV2P32; exact-product nameplate photograph prints GV2-P32. Source rocker-lever description conflicts with documented rotary knob.
Historical sheets specify thermal adjustment 24–32 A and magnetic trip 416 A. AC 50/60 Hz; voltage capability 690 V AC is not assigned nominal voltage. No installed trip setting is inferred.
2017 manufacturer sheet gives Icu 35 kA at 400/415 V; 2019 sheet gives 50 kA there. Breaking capacity is voltage- and revision-dependent; see research.md.

Diagram terminal markings are retained verbatim. Three poles are ganged; open means OFF/tripped reference state. Contacts do not establish permanent net continuity. Thermal/magnetic dynamics are not simulated.
Auxiliary blocks and voltage releases are separate accessories, excluded from this bare order. Connections remain application-dependent.

connectionCoverage.notes: Six main screw-clamp connections of the bare GV2-P32, established by its exact-product sheet diagram. No integral auxiliary, PE, shield, return supply or communication connection is specified; separately ordered accessories are excluded.
